section-divider.comment: A line starting with '=' - runScript.pde's sanitizeScriptLine skips these entirely (plain '=======' dividers, as command/test/views.svs uses between viewports, or an '=Section Name' marker).
section-divider.name: comment.block.section-divider.svs

command.comment: The command name: the first token on a line. Command names in this DSL aren't plain words - REC.png, Shade.Materials, +MapZoom, N.E./S.W., 3d-model, 1D>GROUP, BOX2P all appear as real command names (see runScript.pde's switch-case and command/README.md), hence the wide character class.
command.name: keyword.control.command.svs

key-value-numeric.comment: key:value or key=value where value is a number - the common case (Box m:0 x:-10 dz:8, Person m=0 x=-20). Three captures so the key, the separator, and the number can each get their own scope/colour.

key-value-generic.comment: key:value or key=value where the value isn't purely numeric (rarer, but the parser doesn't require it - see runScript.pde's tokenizeScriptLine, which just turns '=' into ':' either way).

strings.comment: tokenizeScriptLine strips quotes before parsing, but a person may still type a quoted value (e.g. SETLAT "45.5").
strings.name: string.quoted.double.svs

numbers.comment: A bare number not part of a key:value/key=value pair - a trailing argument (Date 80, Day 15, Show Raw Lines 1), or one entry of a comma-separated coordinate list (16,-4,0 16,4,0 ...).
numbers.name: constant.numeric.svs

bare-word.comment: Catch-all for remaining identifiers: multi-word command captions' trailing words (Select last, Show Statistical Ranges, next graph index, Delete All-Model2Ds), not otherwise styled.
bare-word.name: support.function.svs
